tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: First ionisation enthalpy values of first four group 15 elements are given below. Choose the correct value for the element that is a main component of apatite family :

solution.text:
The main component of apatite family is phosphorus.
Order of $\mathrm{IE}_1$ of group 15 elements $\mathrm{N}>\mathrm{P}>\mathrm{As}>\mathrm{Sb}$ IE of phosphorus $=1012 \mathrm{~kJ} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}$.
